name: Ty Winn
strengths: Winn locks his hands on the edge and drives the end 10 yards down the field before he buries him.
Winn washes the down block and collapses the front so the back has a lane.
Winn finishes with a pancake — he keeps the grip and puts the rusher in the turf.
Winn uses that 6-7.5 wingspan to engulf high-school ends before they get a second move.
weaknesses: Winn's kick slide is still heavy-footed and the tall pad level will get tested by true edge speed.
comparison: Winn comps to Walker Little — 6-7 / 313 long tackle who wins with length and a nasty finish before the lower half fills.
projection: Winn projects as a Year 1 developmental tackle, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside if the feet catch the frame.
schemeFit: Winn fits a vertical-set tackle who can maul in the run game while the pass set gets cleaner.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Bonner sophomore reel (embed 27446373 / 694ee444e973529892f8a3d5). Comp height-matched within ~1 inch — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Ty Winn is a 2028 OT · listed 6-7.5 / 255 · Monsignor Bonner (Drexel Hill, PA) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the drive-block bury and the wingspan; Winn is a true 6-7.5 mauler.
insiderNotes: Winn is a 6-7.5 / 255 tackle who locks his hands and drives the end 10 yards before he buries him. He washes the down block and finishes with a pancake. The length is real. The feet still have to catch that tall frame in pass protection.
